{{Quote|Just trying to make a living. At least there's still people in the galaxy who know our value.|Esok explaining his clan's position during the Dark Wars|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
A '''clan''' of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] were active during the [[Dark Wars]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], seeking to do work. However, when traveling with the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]], [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]] attempted to recruit the clan to his quest in reuniting the clans. [[Esok]], the leader of the clan, refused to follow him and attempted to take [[Mandalore's Mask]] to become the new [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mand'alor]]. Esok was then killed and the other members of clan joined Mandalore the Preserver on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]].<ref name="The Sith Lords" />
